content.short: Rubic is a cross-chain swap toolkit that helps apps and users route token trades across many chains from one integration.
content.description: Rubic is a cross-chain swap and bridge aggregator built for wallets, dapps, and traders that need broad liquidity coverage from one connection. Its official product pages position the platform around API, SDK, and widget tools that aggregate hundreds of DEXs, bridges, and routing providers across EVM and non EVM networks, including TON and Mantle. Teams can embed swaps, bridging, fee sharing, and chain abstracted asset flows without building their own routing stack from scratch, while still giving users broad token and network access inside one product experience.
content.meta: Rubic provides cross-chain swap, bridge, and routing tools for apps that want broad liquidity access through one integration.
